question: Qual a categoria de produto que gerou mais receita em pedidos pagos parcelados em mais de 3 vezes?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.category_name_pt, 
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_category_revenue 
FROM marts.fct_order_items oi 
JOIN marts.dim_products p 
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id 
JOIN marts.fct_orders o 
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id 
JOIN marts.fct_order_payments op 
    ON o.order_id = op.order_id 
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' 
  AND op.payment_installments > 3 
GROUP BY p.category_name_pt 
ORDER BY total_category_revenue DESC 
LIMIT 1;
